en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a traditional guesthouse with a steep gabled roof and timber cladding, set along a village street lined with trees. In front of the building are outdoor tables and chairs with several people seated, suggesting a café or inn terrace. A fuel pump stands near the road. The building signage and the printed caption are in German, and the scene evokes a rural holiday or spa village atmosphere.
